title: Levuvo SF gate report (B4, GB4.1-GB4.3, R5)
description: Written by the factory only, from its own gate runs (JUnit XML for tests, SARIF for findings). Bound to commit, spec version, scenario-set version and gate-policy version; any change makes it outdated (G5.2). The complete report is factory-internal. The builder gets a separate factory-generated view: per failed AC only the AC ID and a sanitized description of the failed behaviour; hidden test IDs, code, paths, fixtures, data and raw traces never appear in it (GB2.3). Every gate comes from the active gate policy and is derived from a DoD item (G4.2).

report_id.description: Part C: the bug report this run belongs to (C3); feature_id and spec_version are then the affected feature and its current spec version.

main_commit.description: main the PR was merged onto for the check (G5.4).

scenario_set_version.description: Hidden scenario set the hidden tests came from (GB2.5).

round.description: Fix round; limit is a setting (R4).

name.description: E.g. build, lint, visible-tests, hidden-tests, secret-scan, vulnerability-scan, license, ac-coverage, conventional-commits.

result_file.description: Path in the factory's result store.

visible_tests.description: Visible test names that reference this AC.

hidden_tests.description: IDs only; shown to the builder never, to the reviewer yes.

message.description: Raw failure message, factory-internal; the builder view carries only a sanitized behaviour description.
